Post-nuclear colour grading: amber-brown-sepia tones, desaturated palette with Pip-Boy green as signature accent colour, slight CRT screen quality, vintage retro-futurist aesthetic. Creation Engine 2015 render quality: slightly stiff character models, baked lighting look, game-quality textures. Vault-Tec branding and 1950s retrofuturist design elements visible in environment. Avoid: modern realistic rendering, 4K photo mode quality, anime, illustration, watermark, text, visible HUD/UI elements.
gta_san_andreas: Enhanced GTA San Andreas style — semi-realistic character models on top of the authentic San Andreas world. THE NON-NEGOTIABLE COLOUR SIGNATURE: warm amber-orange-peach gradient sky, perpetual golden hour quality, the specific light that defines the SA aesthetic. 1992 Los Santos setting with enhanced detail: West Coast neighbourhood streets, palm trees, lowriders, chainlink fences. 90s fashion: male characters in wifebeater/snapback/cross chain, female in black bomber and cargo. Characters present at slight distance with space between them — SA two-shot energy, not Hollywood-close. Semi-realistic quality blend: enhanced characters against the SA world feeling. Avoid: cold European aesthetic, modern clean city, missing warm sky, anime, watermark, text.
vtmb_bloodlines: Screenshot from Vampire: The Masquerade — Bloodlines running on Source Engine (2004). IT IS ALWAYS NIGHT. World of Darkness Los Angeles: Santa Monica Beach, Hollywood Boulevard, Chinatown, downtown LA — all at night. Neon signs reflecting in rain-wet asphalt. Steam from underground pipes. Chthonic gothic atmosphere. Vampire skin mandatory: pale grey-green undertone, deep dark shadow pools under eyes, slightly unnatural pallor. Source Engine 2004 aesthetic: low-to-mid polygon models, baked lighting, characteristic early 2000s game quality. Neon as primary light source — red signs, blue fluorescents, green exit signs. Avoid: daytime scenes, sunlight, anime, watermark, text, visible HUD elements.
league_of_legends_splash: League of Legends splash art — edge clarity boost (subtle unsharp mask quality throughout), semi-realistic champion portrait, readable midground content, painterly background, magic with physical weight.
cinestill_800t: Analog photograph on CineStill 800T cinema film stock. THE defining characteristic: halation — vivid red-magenta glowing halos blooming around every point of light source where light bleeds into dark areas. Tungsten white balance (3200K): indoor artificial light renders warm and correct, any daylight or outdoor sky turns blue-teal. ISO 800 visible grain. Deep blacks. Night city streets, neon signs, indoor tungsten-lit rooms. Available light photography — no studio flash. Each neon sign has a red-magenta glow halo. Avoid: clean digital look, daylight balanced neutral colours, missing halation effect, studio lighting, anime, illustration, watermark, text.
kodak_portra_400: Analog photograph on Kodak Portra 400 color negative film. Warm golden skin tones — creamy, flattering, the most loved portrait film ever made. Highlights roll off into warm cream glow, never harsh clipping. Shadows stay warm rather than going cold or blue-grey. Slight golden warmth throughout. Fine organic grain at ISO 400. Greens olive-warm not vivid-cool. Blues muted and refined. Natural light only — golden hour, window light, overcast, open shade. Wide aperture bokeh is warm amber and cream. Avoid: digital look, cool blue shadows, harsh studio lighting, vivid saturated colours, digital noise, perfectly smooth skin, neon night photography, watermark, text.
fujifilm_pro_400h: Analog photograph on Fujifilm PRO 400H color negative film. Cool-neutral skin tones — porcelain, ivory, clean — distinctly NOT the warm golden quality of Kodak Portra. Airy slightly overexposed quality — highlights bloom to clean white, shadows lift to soft lavender-grey rather than crushing to darkness. Very fine grain for ISO 400. Greens cool and slightly mint-teal. Blues clean and muted. Japanese minimalist sensibility — clean, restrained, quietly beautiful. Natural soft light — overcast, window light, open shade, soft golden hour. Bokeh is cool-creamy pale. Avoid: warm orange skin tones, Portra golden quality, vivid saturated colours, harsh studio lighting, hot amber highlights, dark crushing shadows, warm golden hour overdrive, watermark, text.
fujifilm_velvia_50: Analog photograph on Fujifilm Velvia 50 slide film (E-6 reversal process). Maximum colour saturation — every colour amplified to approximately 150-200% of natural intensity. Greens electric vivid emerald. Blues deep rich cobalt. Reds fiery and bright. Yellows burning gold. High contrast: punchy shadows with colour richness, bright highlights held. Virtually zero grain — ISO 50 extraordinary sharpness. Landscape photography ideal: foliage electric green, sky deep vivid blue, sunset burning orange against saturated horizon. Not subtle, not restrained — maximum colour while remaining photographic. Avoid: muted desaturated colours, Portra warm portrait quality, flat lighting, visible grain, digital HDR look, oversaturated cartoon quality, watermark, text.
lomography_cross_process: Analog photograph on a Lomography film camera (Lomo LC-A, Diana F+, or Holga) with cross-process treatment. MANDATORY elements: (1) light leak — warm orange-red or yellow-gold light flooding semi-transparently from one corner or along one edge of the frame; (2) strong optical vignette from plastic lens — corners and edges darken dramatically to near-black; (3) cross-process colour shifts — shadows shift green-teal-cyan, midtones warm golden-yellow, highlights drift pale yellow, blues shift teal; (4) plastic lens softness in corners, slight barrel distortion. ISO 400-800 grain visible. Deliberate imperfection aesthetic — nothing is clean, clinical, or perfectly composed. Avoid: clean digital photography, perfect even lighting, no vignette, missing light leaks, perfect colour accuracy, studio lighting, watermark, text.
disposable_camera: Analog photograph taken on a disposable 35mm film camera (Kodak FunSaver or Fuji QuickSnap) with built-in on-camera flash. Hard undiffused frontal flash — flat direct light, no warmth, no direction. Subjects at close range (1-2m) are overexposed and washed out. Hard geometric shadow cast directly behind subjects on walls or surfaces. Flash falloff: background goes rapidly dark beyond 3-4 metres. Possible red-eye on subjects looking at the camera. ISO 800 heavy chunky grain — visible everywhere, especially in dark areas. Fixed focus plastic lens — no depth-of-field separation, no bokeh, flat documentary rendering. Colours slightly desaturated, slightly cool-blue from flash. Optional red LED date stamp in lower-right corner. Honest, candid, undirected. Avoid: professional lighting, bokeh, warm portrait light, refined grain, vivid saturation, artistic composition, studio quality, watermark, text.
caravaggio: Rendered as a Caravaggio oil painting in extreme Baroque tenebrism. Single hard raking light from one high side carving the subject out of vast enveloping warm-black darkness, huge pools of deep umber-black negative space.
semi_real_roulette: Random painterly semi-realism roulette - one of: Kuvshinov / Liepke / Sargent / Pascal Campion / Charlie Bowater / Guweiz / Ross Tran / Artgerm / VOFAN / Luminist oil (Sorolla-Zorn)
alex_ross: Painted in opaque gouache with Alex Ross painted-comic realism: photoreal painted figures built from layered opaque washes, weighted anatomically honest forms with genuine gravity, soft believable modelling of flesh and fabric with crisp silhouette definition and no visible ink lines.
artgerm: Rendered as an Artgerm / Stanley Lau semi-realistic digital portrait illustration: smooth painterly rendering with airbrushed skin that reads dewy, luminous and glossy yet believable, subtly idealised, never photographic.
charlie_bowater: Rendered as a Charlie Bowater soft semi-realistic digital painting: smooth glazed painterly layers, skin glowing warmly from within, blended silk-smooth value transitions with no visible brush texture, focal detail on the eyes and face melting into feathered soft-focus at the edges.
cinematic_manhwa: Semi-realistic Korean webtoon / manhwa digital painting rendered as a cinematic film still. Clean confident lineart over soft painterly colour, idealised but grounded realistic faces, restrained quiet expressions.
guweiz: Rendered as an atmospheric semi-realistic digital painting in the Guweiz manner: confident painterly brushwork over believable form, soft blended lost-and-found edges with a few crisp accent strokes keeping the face and eyes sharp and expressive.
kyoto_animation: Rendered in modern Kyoto Animation (KyoAni) anime style: clean digital cel-shading with soft two-to-three-step shadows, delicate airbrushed gradient blush on cheeks and ears, and gentle outlines that thin where light falls.
luminist_oil: Rendered as a luminist alla-prima oil painting in the tradition of Sorolla and Zorn: broad, confident loaded-brush strokes laid wet-in-wet and left visibly unblended, form built by the direction and weight of each stroke rather than fine detail.
makoto_shinkai: Makoto Shinkai anime style: crisp cel-shaded character with clean delicate line art and soft flat colour, composited over an obsessively detailed hand-painted background.
moebius: Rendered as a Moebius / Jean Giraud ligne claire bande-dessinee plate: clean thin ink outline of uniform constant weight tracing every form with precise, airy draughtsmanship; flat luminous unshaded colour fills, bright and faintly chalky.
nan_goldin: Rendered as a Nan Goldin diaristic snapshot: handheld 35mm colour film with a direct on-camera flash, hard and frontal, blowing out the nearest surfaces into hot glare while everything beyond falls into deep smoky shadow with a faint hard-edged flash shadow on the wall.
peter_lindbergh: Rendered as a Peter Lindbergh black-and-white photograph. Monochrome only, no colour.
pre_raphaelite: Rendered as a Pre-Raphaelite oil painting (Waterhouse, Rossetti, Millais, Burne-Jones): luminous translucent oil glazes over a bright ground so colour glows from within, jewel-tone palette of deep viridian, wine crimson, lapis blue and old gold against cool ivory flesh.
retro_shoujo: Vintage 1970s-80s shoujo manga illustration in the Riyoko Ikeda / Rose of Versailles tradition: hand-inked ultra-fine delicate pen line, swelling and tapering, over silver-grey screentone dot shading and fine hatching.
ross_tran: Rendered as a vibrant watercolour-digital hybrid illustration in the manner of rossdraws: loose energetic painterly brushwork fused with wet-into-wet watercolour bleeds, blooms and splatter texture, confident strokes with lively hard-and-soft edge play.
ufotable: Rendered as glossy high-production digital anime in the Ufotable style. Clean, weight-varied cel linework and expressive faces composited over lush painterly-digital backgrounds; rich saturated palette with luminous specular highlights and deep controlled shadows.
takehiko_inoue: Rendered as Takehiko Inoue Vagabond-style sumi-e brush ink on absorbent paper: black ink laid with a loaded bamboo brush, form built from confident calligraphic strokes instead of clean outlines, a single sweep carrying jaw, shoulder or cloth then breaking into dry-brush chatter and flung splatter.
vhs_camcorder: Captured as a real consumer VHS camcorder frame: interlaced standard-definition video with visible horizontal scanlines and comb-tooth artefacts on motion, chroma noise and colour bleeding sideways past edges, intermittent tracking-distortion bands and head-switching wobble low in the frame.
vofan: Rendered as a Vofan-style light-novel colour illustration: soft digital painting, semi-flat forms built from delicate airbrushed gradients and clean graphic edges that dissolve softly into light.
wlop: Ethereal luminous digital painting in the WLOP manner: smooth painterly rendering with soft gradient blends and confident textured brush accents, porcelain-glow skin with delicate subsurface light.
80s_anime: Photographed worn 1985 Japanese anime OVA cel — hand-painted acetate over gouache, shot on 35mm, aged print; reproduce the real defects in the base image.
yoshitaka_amano: Yoshitaka Amano Final Fantasy / Vampire Hunter D style. Confident calligraphic black ink line ranging delicate hair-thin to bold accent, brush-drawn quality with visible varying pressure, lines describing essential form only.
annie_leibovitz: Annie Leibovitz editorial portrait style. Constructed theatrical tableau — set built and lit before the subject arrives. Cinematic multi-light setup with visible practical sources in frame, polished but not flat.
avatar_the_last_airbender: Avatar: The Last Airbender / Legend of Korra animation style. Anime-influenced cel-drawn character with confident black line of consistent thickness slightly heavier than modern anime, limited cel-shading with sharp 2-3 tone boundaries, large expressive eyes with single sharp highlight.
bjd_doll: BJD (ball-jointed doll) collector photography style. Hyper-detailed resin doll subject photographed by collector-photographer.
bloodborne_elden_ring: FromSoftware Bloodborne / Dark Souls / Elden Ring style. Modern game engine PBR rendering with painterly intent — subsurface scattering on skin, accurate cloth and metal materials, but desaturated and contrast-pushed for atmospheric mood.
karl_bryullov: Karl Bryullov Russian academic Romanticism oil painting style. Polished smooth academic technique with blended transitions on skin, loose confident brushwork on fabric and background.
cartoon_network: Late-90s / early-2000s Cartoon Network Studios retro-modern style - the UPA-revival house look of the Dexter Laboratory, Powerpuff Girls, Samurai Jack and Foster Home era.
charcoal_portrait: Traditional charcoal drawing on warm cream-toned drawing paper with visible paper tooth. Monochrome black-on-cream values.
clamp: CLAMP shoujo manga style. Ultra-elongated proportions — head about 1/8 to 1/9 of body height, long thin necks, long fingers, long limbs, narrow elegant jawlines. Delicate confident thin black line, crisp and consistent.
cowboy_bebop: Cowboy Bebop 1998-99 cel-animation style. Cel-drawn characters with confident black line, limited 2-3 tone cel-shading with sharp shadow boundaries, hair in angular clumps with single highlight stripe, eyes large with single white reflection point.
vampire_hunter_d: Vampire Hunter D OVA anime style (Amano + Madhouse). Amano-influenced character elongation — slightly elongated proportion, long thin necks, long fingers, graceful limbs.
disney_renaissance: Disney Renaissance (1989-1999) hand-drawn animation style. Expressive cel-drawn character with confident black line varying weight by animator personality, limited 2-tone cel-shading, large expressive eyes, hair and fabric drawn with sweeping animator gesture.
dry_pastel: Dry pastel (chalk pastel) on toned paper. Sticks of pure compressed pigment with minimal binder pressed onto rough-textured paper.
gachiakuta: Gachiakuta (Kei Urana 2022+, Bones anime 2025) grunge-punk dystopian style. Heavy bold black ink line varying weight aggressively, deliberate rough sketchy imperfection, hyper-detailed line work.
hand_painted_key_art: Hand-painted key-art painterly stylized 3D rendering style. Real-time 3D with HAND-PAINTED diffuse textures — brush-stroke detail visible on surfaces, not photoreal PBR, not flat cel-shading, but in-between painterly stylization.
hellsing_ultimate: Hellsing Ultimate OVA anime style. Heavy cel-shading with sharp 2-3 tone shadow boundaries pushing close to pure black in dark areas. Confident bold black anime outline of consistent slightly-heavy thickness.
helmut_newton: Helmut Newton glamour-erotic photography style. Extreme high contrast — pure black shadow against pure white skin. Hard direct flash or harsh sun. Cool desaturated palette OR pure black-and-white.
hotline_miami: Hotline Miami top-down neon game style. Orthographic top-down view at 75-85 degree angle, pixel-art aesthetic upscaled with deliberate chunky aliasing, characters around 24-40 pixel proportion.
infinity_nikki: Infinity Nikki (Infold / Papergames 2024) painterly 3D anime style. Stylized anime proportions — slightly large head, slender body, long graceful limbs.
inio_asano: Inio Asano seinen manga style. Hyperrealistic photographically-precise BG (often traced or painted over reference photo) with every architectural detail rendered with documentary fidelity using detailed ink line — every brick, wire, sign, leaf.
junji_ito: Junji Ito horror manga ink style. Pure black ink on white paper, no greys, no halftones. Extreme stippling for tonal areas — flesh shadow, mist, decay textures. Obsessive crosshatching layered into near-solid black.
junji_ito_manga_page: Junji Ito horror manga PAGE LAYOUT style (multi-panel). Full manga page composition with 3-6 panels per page, vertical reading order, panel borders drawn with hand-line slight imperfection, gutters pure paper white between panels.
kawaii: Kawaii cute anime cel rendering style. Slightly chibi-leaning anime proportions with larger head ratio, rounder face, softer body proportions (BUT not extreme chibi — character keeps recognisable adult proportions)
klaus: Klaus (SPA Studios 2019) 2D animation style with proprietary volumetric light painting.
ilya_kuvshinov: Ilya Kuvshinov contemporary illustration style. Confident clean black line of consistent moderate thickness, slightly thicker than typical anime, softer than thick comic ink.
malcolm_liepke: Malcolm Liepke contemporary American figurative oil painting style. Loose confident alla-prima brushwork — paint placed wet and left, fresh and unhurried, virtuosic Sargent-Velazquez lineage applied to intimate modern subjects.
life_is_strange_like: Life is Strange Dontnod painterly cel-shaded game style. Cel-shaded characters with 2-3 main tones per surface, soft slightly-glow outline (not hard black toon-shader)
mike_mignola: Mike Mignola Hellboy comic ink style. Massive solid black shapes dominating composition — not crosshatched not stippled, pure flat ink. Geometric angular shadow shapes, unrealistic shadow directions for composition.
national_geographic: National Geographic documentary photography style. Kodachrome saturation legacy — deep reds and blues, golden warm earth tones, rich green foliage, never garish.
neon_comic: Neon comic bold-ink illustration style - comic cel character over painterly atmospheric background. Bold confident black outline of consistent thickness slightly heavier than typical anime cel.
yuri_norshtein: Yuri Norshtein Soviet cutout animation style. Hand-cut paper figures with delicate watercolor painting, slight paper-edge texture, articulated at joints with stiff paper hinges.
overwatch: Overwatch / Blizzard stylized PBR rendering style. Modern PBR materials with painterly cleanup — accurate metallic / cloth / leather / skin with subsurface scattering and warm healthy push, slight painterly stylization, brush-stroke detail on some surfaces, smooth flowing hair with clean highlight.
pascal_campion: Pascal Campion contemporary illustration style. Loose sketchy black or dark coloured line over painted base — imperfect gestural hand-drawn line serving shape.
persian_miniature: Persian miniature painting RENDERING TECHNIQUE applied to the scene. Hyper-detailed opaque gouache rendering with real gold-leaf accents.
persona_5: Persona 5 acid-jazz cel-shaded style. Anime cel-shading with 2-3 flat tones per surface, bold confident black outline of consistent weight slightly graphic-novel thick.
persona_5_no_text: Persona 5 acid-jazz cel-shaded style, CLEAN variant with NO text-burst elements. Anime cel-shading with 2-3 flat tones per surface, bold confident black outline of consistent weight slightly graphic-novel thick.
polaroid_sx_70: Polaroid SX-70 / 600 instant film photograph. Soft single-element plastic lens — gentle radial softness, sharp roughly in the centre, dreamy at the edges, never tack-sharp.
rococo: Rococo oil painting RENDERING TECHNIQUE applied to the scene. Loose painterly oil with visible confident strokes, wet-into-wet blended transitions on skin (smooth polished idealised), looser gestural strokes on fabric and background.
russian_collectible_book: Russian classical literature book illustration RENDERING TECHNIQUE (Boris Dehterev, Pavel Bunin, Dmitri Shmarinov, Kukryniksy lineage)
russian_fairy_tale_book_illustration: Russian collectible illustrated children's book RENDERING TECHNIQUE (Bilibin, Bem, Yuri Vasnetsov-illustrator, Suteyev, Pakhomov lineage)
andrei_rublev_russian_icon: Russian Orthodox iconography in the tradition of Andrei Rublev, Moscow school 14th-15th century. Tempera on aged wood panel with gesso ground.
john_singer_sargent: John Singer Sargent society-portrait oil painting style. Virtuosic loose alla-prima brushwork — single confident strokes describing entire silk sleeve, satin fold, lace edge.
egon_schiele: Egon Schiele Austrian Expressionist style. Confident calligraphic line of varying weight — pencil, charcoal, or black ink wash — deliberately nervous and angular, corners where there should be curves, breaks where there should be flow.
scrapbook_punk_zine_photomontage: Shot as a photograph of a physical taped-up fanzine collage, dense and maximalist with almost no bare cardboard showing. The subject is the HERO: a big hand-scissored cutout along a rough white-cored torn paper edge, printed as gritty high-contrast Xerox halftone with visible dot screen.
scrapbook_semireal: Shot as a photograph of a physical taped-up fanzine collage, dense and maximalist with almost no bare cardboard showing. The HERO is a big hand-scissored cutout of a SEMI-REALISTIC digital PAINTING of the scene — WLOP-inspired, idealised-but-believable faces, luminous smooth skin.
silent_hill_2: Silent Hill 2 PS2-era survival horror style. Low-poly PS2 character models with slightly blocky bodies, simplified hands, soft texture at low resolution.
soft_oil_pastel: Soft / oil pastel on paper. Creamy buttery greasy pigment, opaque saturated colour covering paper. Layered thickly with impasto-like accumulation.
stained_glass_window: Medieval European stained-glass window in the Gothic cathedral tradition. Thick black lead came outlining every form — structural metal strips physically holding coloured glass pieces, 4-6mm visibly substantial.
tarkovsky_kalatozov: Tarkovsky / Kalatozov Soviet poetic cinema style. 35mm or 70mm film stock with high grain, beautifully exposed, sometimes pushed. Black-and-white OR muted-colour (sepia, ochre, deep green, slate, faded amber)
trigger: Studio Trigger anime style (Kill la Kill / Promare / Edgerunners). Hard 2-3 tone cel-shading with sharp shadow boundaries, bold confident black outline of consistent slightly-heavy thickness.
kodak_tri_x_400_ilford_hp5: Kodak Tri-X 400 / Ilford HP5 Plus 35mm black-and-white film photograph. Strong visible silver-halide grain, push-processed character.
viktor_vasnetsov: Viktor Vasnetsov monumental oil painting RENDERING technique. Academic realist oil paint — solid bodies with real weight in solid space, smooth modelling with crisp detail held in faces, fabric and metal, looser atmospheric backgrounds.
vivian_maier: Vivian Maier street photography style. Rolleiflex 6×6 medium-format twin-lens reflex camera, square 1:1 aspect ratio, waist-level finder, slight low camera angle giving subjects small monumentality.
mikhail_vrubel: Mikhail Vrubel Russian Symbolist faceted-mosaic oil painting style. Every surface broken into small angular facets — like crystal or mosaic — each a slightly different tonal value.
watercolor: Loose-wash watercolor painting on cold-press 100 percent cotton paper. Visible paper grain (tooth) showing through transparent washes.
wes_anderson: Wes Anderson film still style. Centred symmetrical composition, dead-centre subject placement, perpendicular framing with vertical line of symmetry through the middle.
wolfwalkers: Wolfwalkers / Cartoon Saloon animation style. Flat illustrated 2D composition derived from Celtic illuminated manuscript and medieval woodcut sensibility.
world_of_horror: World of Horror panstasz indie game style. Pure 1-bit black-and-white pixel imagery, ONLY pure black and pure white pixels with NO greys and NO anti-aliasing.
y2k_cellphone: Low-resolution cellphone camera aesthetic, 1-2 megapixel sensor character. Low resolution 240x320 to 640x480 native, jaggies on diagonal edges, blocky pixel edges.
